note: Eswatini, read on 2026-10-31 on the Government of Eswatini's eVisa portal (evisa.gov.sz, 'Powered and maintained by Government of Eswatini'; the Ministry of Home Affairs deals with visas), its 'Visa Application Guidelines' and 'Visa Requirement Documents' pages. A visit over thirty days, or travel to study or to work, needs a Temporary Residence Permit instead of an entry visa; prospective immigrants apply for a permit under the temporary and/or permanent residency criteria. The Temporary Residence Permit is written twice, for work and for study (one permit, two purposes the page names). The requirement documents list categories 'Employee – Part I', 'Business Person – Part II', 'Special Pass', 'Dependent' and 'Students'; that these are the parts of the residence permit and not of a visa is a reading, so they aren't written as routes apart. No fee, term, renewal, decision time, place of application or work right is given; the Ministry's own pages on gov.sz and the Immigration Act weren't read (gov.sz resets the connection).

sources.said: If your visit would exceed thirty days and you had acquired visa to enter the country or if you want to travel to Eswatini to study or to work, you will need to apply for a Temporary Residence Permit instead of an entry visa. ... The Kingdom of Eswatini entry visa applications are dealt with directly at the Ministry of Home Affairs Headquarters ... Prospective immigrants almost certainly need to apply for a permit under the temporary and/or permanent residency criteria. ... Powered and maintained by Government of Eswatini.
